committee: Postponed FY27 Budget Hearing on April 15, 2026-Office of Finance and Budget (OFB)
title: Håfa Adai, The Committee on Finance and Government Operations will be postponing the budget hearing scheduled for Wednesday, April 15, 2026 at 9AM, due to unforeseen weather conditions. A new date will be announced, as we work to reschedule the public hearing, under safer conditions. Thank you for your understanding. The Committee on Finance and Government Operations will conduct a budget hearing on Wednesday, April 15, 2026, beginning at 9:00 am at the Public Hearing Room in the Guam Congress Building.
